description: Retrieve facts for a device using SNMP. The facts are inserted to the ansible_facts key.

parameters.name: community
parameters.description: The SNMP community string, required if version is v2 or v2c.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Set to target SNMP server (normally {{ inventory_hostname }}).

parameters.name: integrity
parameters.description: Hashing algorithm. Required if version=v3. Choices: "md5" "sha"

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Authentication level. Required if version=v3. Choices: "authNoPriv" "authPriv"

parameters.name: privacy
parameters.description: Encryption algorithm. Required if level=authPriv. Choices: "aes" "des"

parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: Maximum number of request retries, 0 retries means just a single request.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username for SNMPv3. Required if version=v3.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: SNMP Version to use, v2, v2c or v3. Choices: "v2" "v2c" "v3"

examples:
- name: Gather facts with SNMP version 2
  community.general.snmp_facts:
    host: '{{ inventory_hostname }}'
    version: v2c
    community: public
  delegate_to: local

- name: Gather facts using SNMP version 3
  community.general.snmp_facts:
    host: '{{ inventory_hostname }}'
    version: v3
    level: authPriv
    integrity: sha
    privacy: aes
    username: snmp-user
    authkey: abc12345
    privkey: def6789
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: ansible_all_ipv4_addresses
return_values.description: List of all IPv4 addresses. Returned: success Sample: ["127.0.0.1", "172.17.0.1"]

return_values.name: ansible_interfaces
return_values.description: Dictionary of each network interface and its metadata. Returned: success Sample: {"1": {"adminstatus": "up", "description": "", "ifindex": "1", "ipv4": [{"address": "127.0.0.1", "netmask": "255.0.0.0"}], "mac": "", "mtu": "65536", "name": "lo", "operstatus": "up", "speed": "65536"}, "2": {"adminstatus": "up", "description": "", "ifindex": "2", "ipv4": [{"address": "192.168.213.128", "netmask": "255.255.255.0"}], "mac": "000a305a52a1", "mtu": "1500", "name": "Intel Corporation 82545EM Gigabit Ethernet Controller (Copper)", "operstatus": "up", "speed": "1500"}}

return_values.name: ansible_syscontact
return_values.description: The textual identification of the contact person for this managed node, together with information on how to contact this person. Returned: success Sample: "Me <me@example.org>"

return_values.name: ansible_sysdescr
return_values.description: A textual description of the entity. Returned: success Sample: "Linux ubuntu-user 4.4.0-93-generic #116-Ubuntu SMP Fri Aug 11 21:17:51 UTC 2017 x86_64"

return_values.name: ansible_syslocation
return_values.description: The physical location of this node (for example, telephone closet, 3rd floor). Returned: success Sample: "Sitting on the Dock of the Bay"

return_values.name: ansible_sysname
return_values.description: An administratively-assigned name for this managed node. Returned: success Sample: "ubuntu-user"

return_values.name: ansible_sysobjectid
return_values.description: The vendor’s authoritative identification of the network management subsystem contained in the entity. Returned: success Sample: "1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.3.2.10"

return_values.name: ansible_sysuptime
return_values.description: The time (in hundredths of a second) since the network management portion of the system was last re-initialized. Returned: success Sample: 42388
